source_audit.proof: Exact selected F64 transpose from an immutable external source feeds only the left operand of one selected product, then source-closed ordinary elementwise epilogue nodes. A virtual transpose has logical dimensions only; Node0 cannot be used as a scalar cell or any other epilogue input. Complete liveness/read-role closure prohibits escaping/reused views, unproved CFG predecessors, activation boundaries, right transposes, extra products and arbitrary actions. Both omitted factory shapes are independently checked.
source_audit.prior_fusion: Ordinary product/producer-sum recipes are derived independently before view recipes and retained unchanged. A view prefix must contain every step of an existing arithmetic suffix. The view has its own bounded prefix allowance, leaving the original16 compute-node/64 suffix-step limits intact; maximum17 nodes/128 source steps. Sparse metadata stores only actual view prefixes, with no per-block candidate array in unrelated programs.
source_audit.physical_memory: Only original physical external roots are retained, copied and validated under the current synchronous loan. For physical leftKxM and productMxN, left pointer base=row and k stride=M; the admitted full real bank contains every k*M+row. Right remainsKxN row-major. Full source demands/shapes/current owners/context/epoch/retained caller/physical peak and replay checks precede access. Empty output never divides or traverses either axis; empty inner never loads. New output is the existing disjoint initialized final bank. No transpose data bank, canonical value or separate execution boundary exists on the successful new branch.
source_audit.arithmetic: Shared existing ordered dot core handles1/2/4 output rows and adjacent output-column SIMD. Every output starts+0 and performs separate original F64 multiply/add in k order. No horizontal partial sums/reassociation/FMA/arithmetic casts. Pointwise operands/operations retain their exact original tree. NaN input or consumed nonfinite result declines/cancels before canonical publication and restores the full old transpose plus retained old product/epilogue fallback; partial private output is discarded.
source_audit.accounting: The existing NumericProductPrepare/Finish, NumericProductFrame and sealed Loan remain unchanged. Every original transpose/product/epilogue/alias construction, clone, retained-owner, publication/retirement and complete ordinary replay demand remains admitted/charged. Work/comparison never decrease; all other optimization counters exactly match accepted56 except the independently proved source-step transition visit delta. Actual source visits are reduced, never padded.
source_audit.failure_and_authority: All existing frame pointers/issued frame words/count/epoch/site/parent/context/cancel/budget checks remain. Original and decoded genuine/packed images reconstruct private source recipes; wire metadata never grants a view. New tests cover22 loan interposition cases, semantic shape-error ordering, logical/physical caps including a nonempty producer under empty final output, spent comparison, aliases/atomic output and cleanup/retry, late nonfinite cancellation after finite private rows, every odd/empty shape and direct strict kernel canaries.
